data.name: Horror Tales Eats The World
data.detailed_description:
MULTIPLE "FOUND FOOTAGE" SCENARIOS

Each tape reveals the violence and terror that took place in its surroundings through disturbing VHS footage. Filled with bloody images, horrifying events, and unexplained horrors, every recording pulls you deeper into a new nightmare.

WATCH YOUR MICROPHONE NOISE!

The game constantly listens to your microphone input. If you exceed a certain volume level, your character dies instantly.

LOCATION-BASED HORROR STORIES

  • FILE #1 Find Whitney
    Fresh out of prison, Clay enters a mysterious forest in search of his missing sister, Whitney. Deep in the woods, he discovers random VHS tapes documenting horrific events from the past.

    As each tape reveals another piece of the violence that took place in the forest, Clay is drawn deeper into an increasingly dark nightmare.

    He has only one goal: Find Whitney and make it out of the forest alive.

  • FILE #2  Pyramid

    Richie and Alex enter the Amunetra Pyramid to find its hidden treasure and steal it. However, they accidentally awaken an ancient curse. They are no longer alone inside the pyramid: mummies, flesh-eating insects, and more are hunting them. Will they give up the treasure and escape the pyramid… or will they die inside?

  • FILE #3  Space Prison

    James is a prisoner in a space prison. But when an outbreak occurs, a horrifying virus spreads rapidly through the station, infecting everyone. James discovers tapes left by a research doctor and pieces together the clues… Will he manage to escape the space prison and survive the viral nightmare?

FOUND FOOTAGE GAMEPLAY

Experience terror through the perspective of bodycams, phones, and VHS cameras. Explore specific fears and chilling sounds unique to each environment. The visuals and audio will fully immerse you in terrifying stories, keeping you on edge until the very end.

HYPER-REALISTIC ENVIRONMENTS

Crafted with extreme realism to create visually stunning and frightening worlds. Every environment is meticulously detailed to confront you with your worst nightmares.

The Early Access version of the game will include the Forest, with the remaining content coming between now and the full release.

data.short_description: The Ultimate Gore & Terror Experience.Bodycam meets body horror. Explore dark, abandoned, photorealistic environments filled with gore, brutal violence, and terrifying paranormal entities. Find hidden tapes. Uncover bloody tales of horror. Your microphone is listening. Stay quiet. Stay alive
